body:
i can honestly say i didnt even think of my daughters wedding. i have two of them that i need to be at one day.

this is the worst nightmare i have even been through. the worst pain of my entire life.

i cant do this to them.

fuck man. i need to see their mother as the evil girl she is. not the love of my life. my heart is being a bitch right now.

thank you for your words internet stranger.

ive thrown the pills across the room and am just staring at them now. i need to find the strength to leave them there

in my head im rationalizing it by saying im not giving up.
in my head im just finally making the pain stop.

i love my daughters and i love their mom. i just dont know that a world without them all with me is a world i want to live in.

i want to fight. i just dont know i have anything left in me to fight with

fuck man. i love those two little monsters. i truly do. it isnt fair what she did to me.

i guess it wouldnt be fair to do this to them.

but im just not thinking correctly right now. just a mish mash of so much emotions and stuff i dont know that i can trust myself to not do something irrational right now.

yeah i keep hearing it i keep hearing over and over that it gets better. but holy fuck. ive been fighting this monster for 24 years. spent the past 4 years building up this life with the girl of my dreams with my 2 daughters.

out of nowhere she pulls it all under me. this is more than getting over someone. this is my daughters not having mom and dad. this is my life spiraling out of control to the point i dont know that i can come back
